The only designated evacuation point is Naukunda shelter, so Likhu school can't be used as a drop-off.

- **Likhu adults:** A round trip from Naukunda costs 42 minutes (21 each way) and saves a 60-minute deferral penalty for 3 adults. That is worth doing.
- **Benighat adults:** Reaching Benighat farm from Likhu school adds 22 minutes each way, so rescuing them costs at least 44 extra minutes. That is more than their 60-minute deferral penalty once the car's 4-seat limit is taken into account. Rescuing all six would cost 128 minutes in total, against 102 for this plan. I'm deferring them.

<plan>
drive car1 naukunda-shelter likhu-school
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 likhu-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
defer benighat-farm adult 3
</plan>

COST: 102
